requirements.title: Provider pilot readiness must be framed as one governed evidence chain
requirements.acceptance_boundary: covered when release docs, capability delta, product value evidence, and release-state audit reference the readiness chain

requirements.title: v10.9 must not authorize live provider execution
requirements.acceptance_boundary: covered when release boundary and not-proven sections explicitly block live execution, credential safety, billing safety, and provider truth claims

forecast.estimated_token_cost_range: bounded release framing, runtime audits, test and smoke verification
forecast.forecast_boundary: forecast is release planning evidence, not delivery certainty

not_proven: Requirement coverage proves structural linkage only; it does not prove provider pilot execution is actually safe or valuable.
